# Carl Meredith

## Overview

- **Age:** 9  <sub>[v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** Maywater  <sub>[v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)</sub>

## Appearance

Carl has clear, bright, dark-blue eyes and brown hair with glints of gold.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008)_

## Personality

Carl is an inquisitive, nature-loving boy who is fascinated by insects and small creatures. He is generally quiet, though prone to childish recklessness and mischief, such as catching animals or joining in adventurous games. Despite a fear of pain and a tendency to panic when frightened, he possesses a strong sense of honor and accepts punishment bravely when he realizes he has done wrong.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008), [v5 c5 P14](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0014), [v5 c16 P27](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0027), [v5 c17 P21](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0021), [v5 c31 P9](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0009), [v5 c31 P10](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0010)_

- Inquisitive  <sub>[v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005)</sub>

## Goals

- To become a naturalist and explore African jungles  <sub>[v5 c3 P21](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0021)</sub>

## History

Carl Meredith moved to the Glen St. Mary manse with his widowed father, John Knox Meredith, his great-aunt Martha, and his siblings Jerry, Faith, and Una. He soon befriended the Blythe children and spent much of his time exploring Rainbow Valley and studying insects. During a game, Carl dropped an eel into Mrs. Carr's buggy, which caused her horse to bolt and angered the community; though he escaped a whipping from his remorseful father, he felt deeply guilty. Later, after running away from a ghost scare at the old Bailey place, Carl accepted a punishment from his brother Jerry to sit alone on a graveyard tombstone at night; as a result of exposure in a cold rain, he developed double pneumonia and nearly died before recovering. After his recovery, his father remarried, giving Carl and his siblings a loving stepmother in Rosemary West.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P8](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0008), [v5 c2 P25](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0025), [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008), [v5 c4 P44](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0044), [v5 c30 P0](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0000), [v5 c30 P1](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0001), [v5 c30 P22](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0022), [v5 c31 P9](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0009), [v5 c31 P21](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0021), [v5 c31 P26](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0026), [v5 c33 P15](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0015), [v5 c33 P29](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0029), [v5 c33 P33](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0033), [v5 c34 P12](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0012), [v5 c35 P0](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0000)_
